GauS is a render-then-fuse approach for high-fidelity mesh reconstruction from 3DGS inputs without fine-tuning.

It sets itself apart by converting optimized Gaussians directly into textured meshes as a plug-and-play solution, unlike NeRF-based re-training or further fine-tuning required for explicit surface modeling in other methods.
Choose for explicit surface modeling from 3DGS.

This method transfers mesh deformation to 3D Gaussians by calculating vertex transformations using ACAP, interpolating them via barycentric coordinates, and averaging transformations across 8 bound faces.
It sets itself apart by using Gaussian-centric binding and averaging operations for robust deformation transfer.
Choose for transferring cage or box deformations to Gaussians.
